setup.title: Adjust stock
setup.description: Upload a CSV or XLSX file to review stock changes before they are applied.

previewing.title: Checking your file
previewing.description: Comparing each row with the current stock. Nothing is written yet.

clean.title: Review changes
clean.description: {count} to update. Nothing is written until you apply.

errors.title: Some rows have errors
errors.description: {count} to update, {failed} with errors that will be skipped. Nothing is written until you apply.

changed.title: Stock changed since export
changed.description: {count} to update. {changed} skipped because their stock moved after the file was exported.

attention.title: Some rows need attention
attention.description: {count} to update. {failed} with errors and {changed} with stock changed since export will be skipped.

included.title: Review changes
included.description: {count} to update, including {changed} whose stock changed since export. Nothing is written until you apply.

includedErrors.title: Some rows have errors
includedErrors.description: {count} to update, including {changed} changed since export. {failed} with errors will be skipped.

nothing.title: Nothing to adjust
nothing.description: No row in this file would change stock.

submitting.title: Applying changes
submitting.description: Updating stock row by row. Keep this window open.

partial.title: Stock partly updated
partial.description: {count} applied, {failed} failed. Download the error file to fix and retry those rows.

skipped.title: Stock updated, rows skipped
skipped.description: {count} applied. {changed} skipped because their stock changed since export. Export again to count them.

partialSkipped.title: Stock partly updated
partialSkipped.description: {count} applied, {failed} failed and {changed} skipped because their stock changed since export.

none.title: Nothing was applied
none.description: No row changed stock: {failed} failed, {changed} stock changed since export, {unchanged} unchanged.

previewInterrupted.title: Could not check the file
previewInterrupted.description: The connection was interrupted. Nothing was written.

inProgress.title: Still processing
inProgress.description: This adjustment is still running on the server.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: Nothing was applied. Wait a moment and retry.

interrupted.title: Connection interrupted
interrupted.description: The adjustment may have been applied. Retry to find out.

rejected.title: File rejected
rejected.description: Nothing was written. Fix the file and try again.

stockImport.title: Adjust stock

hints.reception: Quantity is the number of units received and will be added to stock.
hints.count: Quantity is the physical count. A correction brings stock to this quantity.

stockImport.reasonHelp: Required, up to 200 characters. Applied to every row that has no reason column of its own.
stockImport.fileLimits: CSV or XLSX · up to 5 MB · {limit} rows

parse.wrongType: Choose a CSV or XLSX file.

stockImport.description: Upload a CSV or XLSX file to review stock changes before they are applied.
stockImport.fileHelp: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB and {limit} rows. Required columns: product (id or slug), quantity (integer). Optional reason overrides the shared reason.
stockImport.countWarning: Count mode brings stock to the counted quantity at the moment each row is applied. Orders placed during the adjustment can still change stock.
stockImport.submitting: Applying the adjustment… Do not close this window.

rowCodes.produit_en_double: Product already listed in this file

requestErrors.format_non_pris_en_charge: Unsupported format. Choose a CSV or XLSX file.
requestErrors.contenu_incoherent: The file content does not match its extension.
requestErrors.classeur_invalide: The workbook could not be read.
requestErrors.colonnes_manquantes: Required columns are missing (product and quantity).
requestErrors.aucune_ligne: The file has no data rows.
requestErrors.cle_idempotence_conflit: This request key was already used for different content. Go back and submit again.
requestErrors.rejected: The adjustment was rejected. No row was applied.

stockImport.interrupted: The connection was interrupted and the adjustment may have been applied. Retry to find out: the same file and request key are reused, so nothing is applied twice.
stockImport.inProgress: The adjustment is still processing. Try again shortly.
stockImport.rateLimited: Too many requests (rate limited). Nothing was applied. Wait a moment, then retry: the same request key is reused, so nothing is applied twice.
stockImport.previewing: Checking the file against current stock… Nothing is written yet.
stockImport.previewFailed: The preview could not be completed. Nothing was written. Retry to check the file again.

preview.failNotice: Rows that will fail are skipped when you apply and reported afterwards.
preview.nothingToApply: Nothing to apply: no row would change stock.

stockImport.emptyQuantityHint: Rows with an empty quantity are skipped.

stockChanged.notice: Stock changed on these rows after the file was exported. They are skipped so the count does not undo those sales or receptions.
stockChanged.noticeIncluded: Stock changed on these rows after the file was exported. They are applied anyway, cancelling the movements made since.
stockChanged.includeHint: Their quantity replaces the current stock, cancelling the movements made since export.
stockChanged.resultSkipped: Rows whose stock changed since export were skipped. Export again to count them.

ready.title: Export stock file
ready.description: Download the products matching your current filters as a file you can fill in and import.

pending.title: Preparing your export
pending.description: Building the file from your filters. This window closes when it is saved.

failed.title: Export failed
failed.description: Nothing was downloaded. Check the message below and try again.

empty.title: Nothing to export
empty.description: No products match the current filters.

blocked.title: Too many products
blocked.description: Narrow the filters to {max} products or fewer to export.

split.title: Large export
split.description: {count} products match. Files over {limit} rows must be split before they can be imported.

modeHints.count: Quantity is pre-filled with the current stock; change only what you counted.
modeHints.reception: Quantity is empty; fill in only what you received.

notices.empty: No products match the current filters.
notices.split: {count} products: the import accepts {limit} rows per file, so split the file before importing.
notices.tooMany: More than {max} products match. Narrow the filters to export.
notices.withdrawn: Withdrawn products are included with an empty quantity; the import skips them.
notices.stale: Import soon after exporting: sales made in between would be undone by a count.

followCatalogue.title: Follow WooCommerce again?
followCatalogue.description: This product's status is set in the panel ({status}), so imports from WooCommerce no longer change it. If you follow WooCommerce again, the shop uses the status WooCommerce gives this product, now and after every import. The status you set here is dropped.

stockIndicator.label: In stock
stockIndicator.hint: A tracked product follows its count. An uncounted one follows WooCommerce until you set its status here, and then ignores later imports. Switch tracking off to set the status whatever the quantity, and count the product with the pencil to track it.

overview.promoHint: Leave empty for “already running” and “no end date”. A discount with no end stays up until someone removes it.
